design_name: ARC V3A (CFS Virginia commercial plant, JPP 2026 special issue)
selection_rationale: ARC V3A is the canonical CFS commercial plant design and the basis for the Chesterfield County (Virginia) plant scheduled for early-2030s construction. As of the June 2026 JPP special issue (Hillesheim et al., Creely, Howard et al., Sweeney et al., Eich et al.), V3A has published engineering parameters — R0 = 4.62 m, B0 = 11.4 T, Ip = 12 MA, P_fus ~1.13 GW, P_e,net >= 400 MW, FLiBe blanket, vanadium structural, XPT divertor — and a documented disruption-mitigation strategy. ARAI (Araiinejad & Shirvan, MIT 2024) provides the techno-economic anchor (350 MWe scale, LCOE $140–$550/MWh). The Sorbom et al. 2015 ARC paper remains the historical/heritage reference for the conservative pilot phase. SPARC is excluded (no net electric output by design).
alternatives_considered: ARC 2015 Conservative Pilot phase (Sorbom et al., heritage reference); ARC 2015 FNSF phase (Sorbom et al., heritage reference); ARC 2015 Aggressive Pilot phase (Sorbom et al., heritage reference); SPARC (CFS, under construction, no net electric); ARAI (Araiinejad & Shirvan MIT 2024, 350 MWe techno-economic variant)
